name: ProductRecallWithdrawalConsole
tagline: Every recalled product off the shelf in time – blocked at the till, counted, quarantined, disposed and confirmed to head office.
description: A complete store recall module for supermarkets, pharmacies and retail chains: recall and withdrawal notices broken into lines per affected item and lot, action-by deadlines, a shop-floor sweep in aisle order for associates on a handheld, removal with a till (POS) sale block and a count against the system stock, a second-person quarantine count with DO NOT SELL tags, return, collection or witnessed destruction with references, customer notices for consumer recalls, exceptions and the store confirmation to head office – with store associate, recall coordinator and store manager roles. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Consumer recalls, trade withdrawals and precautionary stock holds broken into lines per item and lot
Action-by deadlines with due-today and overdue lines
Shop-floor sweep in aisle order with big buttons for handhelds
Removal with till (POS) sale block and count against the system stock
Variance rule with explanations and count tolerance
Second-person quarantine count with automatic count-mismatch exceptions
DO NOT SELL tag previews and tag job CSV
Return to supplier, supplier collection or witnessed destruction with references
Store confirmation to head office with the report
Roles: store associate, recall coordinator, store manager
Power Fx outputs and events (QuarantineTagText, ReportText, SummaryJson)
